levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Misses two or more checks even with adult present.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Completes all three checks with adult support.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Completes all three checks and leads the second round with no prompting needed.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Cannot explain why a check matters beyond 'it's a rule.'

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Explains a plausible specific consequence for at least one check.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Explains a specific, accurate consequence tied to the exact behavior, not a general safety statement.

lookFors: Adult was present for both rounds, not just the first.
Learner never reached into a running machine at any point.
Explanation names a real mechanism (for example a coin damaging the drum), not just “bad things happen.”

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
